name: zcode-auto-compact
description: Makes ZCode's built-in auto-compact trigger at a configurable percentage of the model's context window (default 35%) instead of the engine default. Implemented as a reversible patch to the single getAutoCompactThreshold function in resources/glm/zcode.cjs; nothing else in the engine is touched and no text is injected into the model context. Includes a settings dialog (/compact-settings), engine restore, and self-update through the official zcode CLI.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 让 ZCode 自带的自动压缩按设定的百分比触发（默认为模型上下文窗口的 35%），而不是引擎默认的高阈值。实现为引擎 resources/glm/zcode.cjs 中 getAutoCompactThreshold 一个函数的可还原补丁，不改引擎其它内容，也不往模型上下文注入任何文字。带设置弹窗（/compact-settings）、引擎还原，以及经官方 zcode CLI 的自动更新。
